Implemented the Node.js CNC simulator at [output/main.js](/workspace/output/main.js).

It supports:

- RS274 G/M codes, modal state, expressions, parameters, coordinate systems
- Tool tables and parameter files
- Tool changes, offsets, cutter compensation, probing, canned cycles, arcs, G28/G30
- Block delete
- JSON final-state output and error handling
- Time, distance, and position-tolerance motion traces
- Correct success/error exit codes

Verified with Node.js 22 syntax checks and focused behavior tests.
